# Paper Shaders — pinned subset

Unmodified runtime files from `@paper-design/shaders@0.0.81`, downloaded from
https://registry.npmjs.org/@paper-design/shaders/-/shaders-0.0.81.tgz on 2026-10-02.

Includes ShaderMount, its vertex shader, Warp and Warp's helper modules/noise texture.
LICENSE and NOTICE are preserved. No CDN requests, React or Three.js required.
The upstream package warns of breaking changes during 0.0.x; update explicitly,
then rerun the sky browser suite. Source maps are not included.

Source: https://github.com/paper-design/shaders
